prompt: Femi forgot to charge his phone, so he did not call his dad from the station. If he (to charge) it, he (to call) his dad.
explanation_ru: О несостоявшемся прошлом: if + Past Perfect (had charged), в главной части would have + V3 (would have called).

prompt: Nobody washed the dishes after the party, so the kitchen was a mess on Sunday. If everybody had helped, it ___ a mess.
explanation_ru: Речь о прошлом, которое нельзя изменить: would not have been. Wouldn't be относится к настоящему, hadn't been — форма условия, а не результата.

prompt: If I would have known about the test, I would have studied.
explanation_ru: После if нельзя ставить would have: в условной части нужен Past Perfect (had known), would have — только в главной части.
answer: If I had known about the test, I would have studied.
accepted_answers: If I had known about the test, I would have studied.
If I'd known about the test, I would have studied.
If I had known about the test, I'd have studied.
If I'd known about the test, I'd have studied.

prompt: – Our bus broke down near Preston, but the driver found us a taxi. – Wow. What (you / to do) if he (not / to find) one?
explanation_ru: Вопрос о невозможном прошлом: What would you have done + if + Past Perfect (hadn't found).

prompt: It rained all Saturday, so you stayed in. Where ___ if it hadn't rained?
explanation_ru: Вопрос о прошлом, которое не случилось: would + you + have + V3 (would you have gone). Did you go спрашивает о факте, а не о воображаемой ситуации.

prompt: Aoife didn't ask for help, so she failed the exam. → Would Aoife have failed the exam …
explanation_ru: Вопрос в третьем типе: Would + подлежащее + have + V3, а в условной части — if + Past Perfect (had asked).
answer: Would Aoife have failed the exam if she had asked for help?
accepted_answers: Would Aoife have failed the exam if she had asked for help?
Would Aoife have failed the exam if she'd asked for help?
Would Aoife have failed the exam if she had asked someone for help?
Would Aoife have failed the exam if she'd asked someone for help?

prompt: Build the sentence.
explanation_ru: Вопрос про невозможное прошлое: What would you have done + if + Past Perfect (had been closed).
answer: What would you have done if the shop had been closed?
accepted_answers: What would you have done if the shop had been closed?

prompt: Elodie bought the small flat because she had not saved enough. If she had saved more, she could (to buy) the bigger one.
explanation_ru: После could в третьем условном нужен have + V3: could have bought (возможность в прошлом, которой не было).

prompt: The concert hall was half empty because hardly anyone knew about the show. If the organisers had advertised it better, more people ___ come.
explanation_ru: В нереальном прошлом результат выражается might have + V3. May have и can have выражают реальное предположение, might had — грамматическая ошибка.

prompt: Kemal did not have a ticket, so he could not enter the stadium. → If Kemal had had a ticket, he could …
explanation_ru: Условие — had had (Past Perfect от have), результат — could have + V3: возможность, которой не было в прошлом.
answer: If Kemal had had a ticket, he could have entered the stadium.
accepted_answers: If Kemal had had a ticket, he could have entered the stadium.
If Kemal had had a ticket, he could have got into the stadium.
If Kemal had had a ticket, he could have gotten into the stadium.
If Kemal had had a ticket, he could have gone into the stadium.

prompt: Dorota reached her sister's wedding in time only because the taxi was so fast. If the taxi (not / to be) so fast, she (to miss) the ceremony.
explanation_ru: Факт был противоположным (такси было быстрым): условие с отрицанием hadn't been, результат would have missed.

prompt: Lukasz missed the last tram and walked home for an hour. If he (to leave) the party ten minutes earlier, he (to catch) it. Then he (not / to be) so tired at work the next morning.
explanation_ru: Все три пропуска о прошлом: had left, would have caught, wouldn't have been. Then в последнем предложении заменяет if-часть.

prompt: If Sunniva hadn't lost her keys, she'd have gone to the cinema with us.
explanation_ru: Третий условный меняет полярность обоих частей: hadn't lost значит «потеряла», she'd have gone значит «не пошла».
options: Sunniva lost her keys and went to the cinema with us.
Sunniva didn't lose her keys and went to the cinema with us.
Sunniva lost her keys and didn't go to the cinema with us.
Sunniva didn't lose her keys and didn't go to the cinema with us.

prompt: Gustavo got to the shop at ten past six, but it had closed ten minutes earlier. If Gustavo had known the shop closed at six, he'd gone earlier.
explanation_ru: В главной части 'd означает would, поэтому после него нужен have + V3 (he'd have gone). He'd gone читается как he had gone — это не результат.

prompt: Ottilie forgot her umbrella and got wet on the way to school.

options: If Ottilie brought her umbrella, she wouldn't get wet.
If Ottilie had brought her umbrella, she wouldn't have got wet.
If Ottilie had brought her umbrella, she wouldn't get wet.
If Ottilie would have brought her umbrella, she wouldn't have got wet.

prompt: Radka tells a friend about a job interview that went badly.
explanation_ru: В предложении 3 после if стоит would have: условная часть третьего типа требует Past Perfect (had warned).
sentences: Radka's job interview went badly last Tuesday.
If she had slept more, she would have felt calmer.
If she hadn't lost the address, she wouldn't have arrived late.
If the receptionist would have warned her about the traffic, she would have left earlier.

prompt: Lubna ate too much cake yesterday. If she (not / to eat) so much, she (not / to feel) sick now.

prompt: This morning Casper left his key at home. Now he is standing outside the door. If he (to take) his key, he (to be) inside now.
explanation_ru: Условие относится к утру (had taken), а результат — к настоящему моменту (would be inside now).

prompt: I can't swim well. Yesterday my friends went in the sea, but I stayed on the beach. If I ___ a good swimmer, I would have gone in too.
explanation_ru: Условие касается того, какой я сейчас (не умею плавать), а результат — вчерашнего дня: were … would have gone.

prompt: Ayla did not do her homework yesterday. Now she is in trouble with the teacher.

explanation_ru: Условие о постоянном свойстве человека (were), результат — о конкретном прошлом случае (wouldn't have stayed).

prompt: I did not learn to drive when I was young, so I need lifts from friends. → If I had learned to drive when I was young, I …

prompt: Come ten minutes early ___ you will get the best seats.
explanation_ru: Императив + and = «если сделаешь, то…»; or/otherwise указывают на неприятный результат.
